claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor...

risks.risk: Shutter count / wear level (major value driver for DSLR bodies). Photos cannot show shutter actuations.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera menu showing shutter count (or a service report / shutter count app output).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case for a used body: assume high wear (as-is, no shutter-count proof).

risks.risk: Functional status (AF, buttons, dials, LCD brightness, ports, hot shoe, and whether it powers up reliably). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: Video clip of powering on + navigating menus + taking a short burst; include a quick focus test on a nearby object.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully tested / worst case: assume it may have faults until proven working.

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) and mirror/curtain health. Photos cannot confirm sensor/mirror state.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) plus a close photo of the sensor area (mirror up) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing cleaning/with possible sensor dust (worst-case for image quality).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, body cap, cables) and whether the battery is healthy.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger, cables, strap, lens if any) and a close-up of battery label/charger model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only / incomplete kit until the full bundle is shown.

risks.risk: Authenticity / parts mismatch (less likely but possible with body-only listings). Photos cannot fully verify.
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number plate clearly + a second angle showing matching internal/EXIF info from a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively as a generic used body until authenticity/consistency is confirmed.

proof_requests: Shutter count screenshot (or service report) from the camera or a shutter-count tool.
Video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus test, and a short burst of photos.
Test images: one at f/16 on a blank surface to check sensor dust; plus a sensor/mirror-up photo if possible.
Clear photos of the full included items (battery, charger, body cap/strap) and close-ups of battery/charger labels.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, but key value drivers (shutter count, full functionality, sensor/mirror condition, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the images alone. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be confidently set.
